name: AeroGuard LSTM RUL regressor
trained_on: NASA C-MAPSS FD001 (single operating condition, single fault mode)
description: Two stacked LSTM layers (128 and 64 units) plus a dense head, reading the last 30 cycles of 24 inputs (3 operational settings, 21 sensors). Trained in Keras, served in plain NumPy.
target: Remaining useful life in cycles, capped at 125 during training

metrics.dataset: FD001 official test set, 100 engines, prediction at each engine's last recorded cycle

notes: Predictions never exceed about 125 cycles because training capped RUL at 125. Engines with fewer than 30 recorded cycles are scored on a padded window (first reading repeated), so their estimates are less reliable. Trained only on FD001 data; accuracy on other engine types or operating conditions is unknown.
